fields.value: My Migraine Voice survey: disease impact on healthcare resource utilization, personal and working life in Finland

dsDescriptionValue.value: Abstract Background A global My Migraine Voice survey was conducted in 31 countries among 11,266 adults who suffered from ≥4 monthly migraine days (MMD). The aim of this retrospective observational survey-based study was to analyse the country specific results in Finland in order to understand the impact of migraine based on disease severity. Methods The included participants (3%, n = 338/11,266) were stratified by mean MMDs into 4 ≤ MMD
